trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.why: O brasileiro coloca o particípio logo após have. Em inglês, o objeto vem no meio: have + objeto + particípio.

mcq.q: "I had my phone stolen" pode indicar...
mcq.why: have + objeto + particípio também indica experiência negativa.

opts: Where do you get cut your hair?
Where you get your hair cut?
Where do you get your hair cut?

fix.wrong: She got her nails do yesterday.
fix.right: She got her nails done yesterday.

fix.wrong: I'll have checked my eyes tomorrow.
fix.right: I'll have my eyes checked tomorrow.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o futuro: “I have my car washed.”
rewrite.answer: I will have my car washed.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a negativa: “She had her house painted.”
rewrite.answer: She didn't have her house painted.
